why: docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md section 11 F2: porting one real argo route against the frozen contract shows whether the contract forbids an edge a real route needs, while amendment is still cheap (gate G1).
what: tools/spikes/f2-route/** (own package.json: react and react-dom 19.3.0, typescript 6.0.3, tailwindcss 4.3.5) and docs/v3/spikes/f2-route.md. Default route: argo apps/dashboard/src/routes/strength-tracker.tsx (FilterSet, workouts-table, sparkline-grid-chart); another only if it uses fewer of the five layers. Port into a scratch app with synthetic data, argo untouched. Layers: `./table`, Sparkline, StatGroup, FilterSet, the query client. tsconfig `paths` map `basalt-ui/<subpath>` to packages/basalt-ui/src (alias table: apps/playground/vite.config.ts).
must_not_touch: consumer repos (scratch copies live in the OS temp dir)
contract: docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 1 and 11 F2 and every contract.ts are frozen; amendments are the orchestrator's.
change: Port the route using only the frozen public contract: no deep imports, no eject. `edgesForbidden` = every place the port needed something section 1's `app` row or a `Must not` column forbids (found by an import scan against the section 3 subpath list, tsc errors on missing contract surface, and a hand list `needs[]` with file:line). For each, say `amend` or `port` with the smallest shape. `deepImports` = import specifiers outside the published subpaths of section 3.
commits: One non-package commit `chore: spike f2-route harness and verdict`, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Port rendered at 1800x1200 and 390x844, light and dark, shots under tools/spikes/f2-route/shots/, synthetic data; at most 3 rounds.
acceptance: `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p .` run in the spike folder after `bun install` exits 0
`bun tools/spikes/f2-route/run.ts` exits 0, prints one JSON object with the keys above (0 = harness ran, not hypothesis held)
docs/v3/spikes/f2-route.md has headings Question, Method, Measurements, Verdict, Then, Affects and the `verdict` lines
out_of_scope: The real argo cutover; fixing contract files; more than one route.
envelope: Harness: tools/spikes/<dir>/ has its own package.json (exact pins); bun.lock and node_modules gitignored there (must_not_touch package.json and bun.lock = repo root only). Passes root oxlint; no *.test.* files; Chrome via the playwright-core pattern of packages/basalt-ui/tests/layout/harness.ts; docs/v3 on master before filing; synthetic data only, private repos as counts and hashed ids.
verdict: `F2: PASS|REFUTED`: PASS iff tsc exits 0, `edgesForbidden` is empty, `deepImports` and `ejects` are 0; REFUTED then lists one `amend` or `port` line per edge. `Verdict:` equals F2; run.ts `verdict` the same.
